note: tree not on disk; lines from upstream tag release-0.4.4 on GitHub. Line numbers are 0.4.4 coordinates derived from the old side of GitHub compare diffs (release-0.4.4...<fix>), cross-checked against published sanitizer traces (0.4.5 md4c.c has identical line numbering to 0.4.4: every 0.4.4->0.4.5 hunk is same-size; 0.4.7 = 0.4.4 + 37 after line 5814). ENTRY CAVEAT: md2html reads input into a malloc'd 32KiB-growing membuf that is NOT NUL-terminated and always has >=1 byte of spare capacity, so the 1-byte past-the-end reads below are uninitialized-memory reads under md2html (MSan-visible, ASan-invisible); under an exact-size harness (e.g. OSS-Fuzz fuzz-mdhtml / libFuzzer md_html(data,size)) they are ASan heap-buffer-overflow READ 1. Excluded (fixed before 0.4.4): CVE-2018-11536/11545/11546/11547 (0.2.5), CVE-2018-12102/12112 (0.2.6). Excluded (introduced after 0.4.4): md4c #173/#174/#212/#213, OSV-2022-40/42/126, ARVO 42507295/42507297/42508248/42507371 (all regressed by Jan-2022 commits db9ab41/62b6097/f7c8db7), all OSV-2026-* (introduced 2026), #167's md_is_container_mark hunk (introduced by the 0.4.7 #139 fix).

cves.trigger: NUL byte at line start (printf '\0x\n'): ISANYOF_() treats '\0' as a palette member (md_strchr finds the terminator), corrupting parser block state; MSan use-of-uninitialized-value in md_push_block_bytes via md_start_new_block <- md_process_line(6147) <- md_process_doc(6218)
cves.note: Uninitialized-memory use (MSan); class 'other'. Root cause is the macro #define ISANYOF_ at src/md4c.c:279 (identical text present at 0.4.4). Trace lines are from the 0.4.5 report, and 0.4.5 md4c.c line numbering equals 0.4.4. Under ASan alone may not crash (CVE says DoS e.g. assertion failure in DEBUG builds).
